paper.title: Beyond Meta-Reasoning: Metacognitive Consolidation for Self-Improving LLM Reasoning
paper.central_claim: MC2 (Meta-Reasoning Orchestrator inner loop + MetaCognitive Accumulator outer loop) consolidates structured Reasoner/Monitor/Controller traces across a stream into hierarchical meta-knowledge that is compiled into role prompts, yielding best accuracy across four benchmarks and four backbones with gains that grow as experience accumulates.

evidence.quote: These approaches primarily store task-level reasoning content (solutions, templates, or heuristics for solving), whereas we consolidate meta-level experience, how to monitor, critique, and control reasoning, into procedural meta-knowledge that progressively improves future meta-reasoning.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: On the evaluation stream with correctness-tagged feedback, prompt-level consolidation of Reasoner/Monitor/Controller experience raised later-batch accuracy over fixed-prompt and label-free baselines, with a store-off style ablation showing +6 to +8 points on MATH-500/TheoremQA for the updates alone.

assessment.note: retained is scoped to within-task online use of earlier items in the same stream; improver-level evidence absent (consolidator fixed).
assessment.evidence_level_note: Both seats retained, kept and scoped. Lessons written after earlier batches are read on later, different items of a single stream pass, and there is a store-off arm (R+M+C vs Full). Run precedent (r15b Evo-MedAgent, r06a SWE-Exp) admits same-stream store-off evidence as retained. The correctness labels of earlier test items enter the store, and the experience curve uses repeated passes; these are scored in E.holdout = 1. The repeated-pass curve on its own would be task.

G.reason: Opus sides with son55. The gap (episodic meta-reasoning with no cross-instance carryover) is real and the changed object (role prompts plus meta-knowledge) is clear. But the closest cross-instance memory neighbours (Reflexion, ReasoningBank) are not compared, BoT is re-implemented best-effort, and the residual 'meta-level not task-level' distinction is asserted. The paper's own Table 10 lists domain tactics in the store (opus:O07).

M.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. The Reasoner/Monitor/Controller factorization gives attributable traces. The chain reflections → batch micro-lessons from best and worst sets → windowed global rules → retrieved lessons compiled into role prompts is reconstructable and makes testable predictions. The 'no ground truth' framing conflicts with label use, and LLM rewrite quality is unchecked.

X.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Algorithm 1, batch-size rule, w=3/k=3, embedding model, trace schema, deterministic reflection heuristics, composer validity checks with fallback, and window forgetting are all specified. There is no utility gate or rollback, conflict resolution is left to an LLM rewrite, and the App I prompt boxes are empty in the pinned HTML (rendering gap).

E.measurement.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Standard accuracy with unified answer parsing, failures counted, and token counts for all methods. Baselines are re-implemented best-effort (TTPI missing on Gemini, Meta-Prompting without the interpreter).

E.causality.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. The ablation ladder includes a store-off arm (R+M+C 79.20 vs Full 85.13 on GPT-4o-mini MATH-500, opus:O05). Missing: a label-free variant to test the stated claim, a static-optimized-prompt or shuffled-lesson control, label-using memory baselines (Reflexion/ReasoningBank) at matched calls, and an S+/S− ablation. The 'grows with experience' curve uses repeated passes.

E.holdout.reason: Both seats 1; re-checked. The adaptation stream is the evaluation stream, and the correctness labels of earlier test items enter the reflections despite the 'no ground truth' framing (App C.1/C.4). The experience curve reuses the same problems over passes, transfer is a warm-start that keeps adapting on the target, and there is no frozen-store or held-out split.

E.statistics.reason: Shared correction (both seats 3). The frozen A2 ladder requires seeds + intervals + significance test for 3. Table 1 has three seeds and 95% CIs but no test of the main comparisons. The Spearman test concerns the proxy, not the effect. Two 'best' cells overlap the strongest baseline (opus:O01–O04), and the ablation, trajectory, iteration and transfer tables are single runs (opus:O05). Run precedent: r14a 2603.23129 and cal-h1 2310.02304 (runs with CIs, no tests → 2).

E.cost.reason: Opus sides with son55. Decoding tokens per instance are reported for every method and dataset, which is a per-variant ledger, and an iteration-budget sweep is given. Whether per-instance composer calls, distillation, consolidation and input tokens are counted is unstated (opus:O06), and there is no matched-compute comparison against label-using memory methods. Consistent with r15b Autogenesis/EvoRAG (per-variant ledger with a key gap → 2).
